ns2:course.label: Discussions in Integrative Biology
ns2:course.description: Seminars, discussions, research project presentations, readings, and reviews of special topics in integrative biology. 1 undergraduate hour. 1 graduate hour. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated if topics vary. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
